precondition: trial has mutated values and physical provisional report events
required_assertion: accepted state owner generations and committed physical events remain unchanged

stimulus: retry same interval with reused then fresh trial id
required_assertion: reused trial id rejected and fresh trial id accepted

precondition: interval identity bound to t0 t1
stimulus: attempt same interval id with changed t1 then new interval id
required_assertion: same id rejected and new interval/frame binding accepted

stimulus: bind same frame id with changed payload or metadata
required_assertion: mutation under same frame id rejected

stimulus: bind external frame referring to producer or ANIMO generation inconsistent with trial binding
required_assertion: stale generation is rejected before synthetic execution

precondition: trial begins from accepted synthetic value
stimulus: apply same-step management mutation then downstream read
required_assertion: downstream read observes G_MUTATED_EVENT value while accepted snapshot is unchanged

precondition: accepted neighbor differs from trial-mutated neighbor
required_assertion: probe returns accepted neighbor and trace generation G_PREVIOUS_NEIGHBOR

precondition: trial contains provisional and physical events
required_assertion: only physical event enters committed journal

precondition: trial records report-only observation and physical event
required_assertion: report observation remains diagnostic and does not enter committed physical journal
accepted-idle checkpoint succeeds and trial-active checkpoint fails

precondition: trial ready with ANIMO hydrology and crop synthetic owners
stimulus: attempt accept with one participant not ready then all ready
required_assertion: failed barrier advances no accepted generation and complete barrier advances all together

classify management and harvest at t0 interior and t1
